title: Add prompt observability and dump tooling
objective: Make prompt construction inspectable and cache behavior diagnosable for parity work without exposing secrets.
context: The original has prompt dump and cache-break-oriented debugging paths.
Go has cache metrics in renderers and a CacheBreakDetector, but the detector result is currently discarded.
Subsequent parity work needs a stable way to compare rendered prompts.
deliverables: Add a CLI prompt dump mode that can print rendered system prompt blocks and context.
Redact obvious secrets and auth headers in dumps.
Add optional cache break debug logging without showing warnings to ordinary users by default.
Preserve existing cache read/create display behavior.
acceptance: A local command can dump the full prompt prefix without making an API call.
JSON dump parses successfully and includes block metadata.
Cache break details can be enabled for debugging but remain quiet by default.
No API keys or auth tokens appear in dump tests.
non_goals: Do not build a web UI.
Do not change default user-facing cache warning behavior.
Do not require the TypeScript source to run.
handoff_notes: This task is a force multiplier for task_12; expose a machine-readable format.
